item.title: CVE-2026-123218 — IBM Aspera Faspex
item.description: Threat Signal 69. IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.
